metadata.title: Example data for the SAFE Project
metadata.description:
Description

This is an example dataset to demonstrate the formatting of tabular datasets for the SAFE project.

Please note that you can use carriage returns within a cell!

Projects

This dataset was collected as part of the following projects:

  • https://safeproject.net/projects/project_view/1

Funding

These data were collected as part of research funded by:

  • NERC (Standard grant , NE/K006339/1 , https://gtr.ukri.org/projects?ref=NE%2FK006339%2F1 )

This dataset is released under the CC-BY 4.0 licence, requiring that you cite the dataset in any outputs, but has the additional condition that you acknowledge the contribution of these funders in any outputs.

Permits

These data were collected under permit from the following authorities:

  • Sabah Biodiversity Centre ( Research licence A-123-456)
  • Sabah Biodiversity Centre ( Export licence B-567-890)

Files

This dataset consists of 1 file: Test_format_good_Seq.xlsx

Test_format_good_Seq.xlsx

This file contains dataset metadata and 3 data tables:

My data table

  • Worksheet: DF
  • Description: This is a test data worksheet
  • Number of fields: 20
  • Number of data rows: 1029
    • Location: SAFE 2nd order point number (type: location)
    • Date: Collection date (type: date)
    • Latitude: GPS Lat for sample point (type: latitude)
    • Longitude: GPS Long for sample point (type: longitude)
    • QuadratNumber: Four replicates (type: replicate)
    • Status: Something (type: numeric)
    • Treat: Something else (type: categorical)
    • Level: Something else (type: categorical)
    • Time: Something else (type: categorical)
    • Rain: Something else (type: numeric)
    • Group: Something else (type: numeric)
    • Obs_Time: A time (type: time)
    • Datetime: A date time field (type: datetime)
    • Taxon: The taxon studied (type: taxa)
    • TagNumber: Pit tags for the ants (type: id)
    • Species_count: The species abundance (type: abundance)
    • Ant_mass: The average individual mass (type: numeric trait)
    • Caste: The caset of the individuals weighed (type: ordered categorical trait)
    • Lizard_predation: Consumption of ants by lizards (type: numeric interaction)
    • Comments: My comments (type: comments)

My incidence matrix

  • Worksheet: Incidence
  • Description: A test data worksheet too
  • Number of fields: 7
  • Number of data rows: 102
    • Location: SAFE 2nd order point number (type: location)
    • Date: Collection date (type: date)
    • Cr_bo: Abundance of species (type: abundance)
    • Do_sp: Abundance of species (type: abundance)
    • Fo_1: Abundance of species (type: abundance)
    • Morph_1: Abundance of species (type: abundance)
    • Cr_bo_mass: Average mass of species (type: numeric trait)

My sequencing data table

  • Worksheet: MicrobeDF
  • Description: Another test worksheet
  • Number of fields: 6
  • Number of data rows: 14
    • Location: SAFE 2nd order point number (type: location)
    • Latitude: GPS Lat for sample point (type: latitude)
    • Longitude: GPS Long for sample point (type: longitude)
    • Species_count: The number of each taxon detected by sequencing (type: abundance)
    • Taxon: The taxon studied (type: taxa)
    • Comments: My comments (type: comments)

Extents

  • Date range: 2012-06-01 to 2012-07-30
  • Latitudinal extent: 4.5° to 5.07°
  • Longitudinal extent: 116.75° to 117.82°
